caption:
A zombie outbreak brings down a jet.
Seedance 2.5 built this whole air disaster.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds, 16:9 horizontal. Ultra-photorealistic Korean disaster-horror blockbuster, shot on large-format digital cinema camera with 35mm and 50mm anamorphic-feel lenses, shallow depth of field, fine film grain. Color grade moves from cool lavender-blue night cabin light, to flashing emergency red, to a final fiery orange. Camera feel: smooth and calm at first, then handheld, shaky and chaotic with motion blur. Pacing: quiet 4-second opening, then rapid cuts every 1-2 seconds that escalate to a single explosive wide ending.

CHARACTERS (identical in every shot):
- THE HEROINE: Korean woman, early 20s, fair smooth skin, soft oval face, full lips, long straight black hair worn loose past her shoulders. Fitted plain white crew-neck short-sleeve T-shirt, light-wash jeans. Signature: pale silver-blue over-ear wireless headphones (on her head at first, then hanging around her neck). In the final shots her face is smudged with dark grime.
- PATIENT ZERO: heavy-set Korean man, about 50, short black side-parted hair, round tired face. Charcoal-grey business suit, white shirt, navy tie, small gold lapel pin. Signature: dark spidery veins spreading up his neck and jaw, then eyes turning solid glowing white.
- THE FLIGHT ATTENDANT: Korean woman, about 30, black hair in a neat low bun. Fitted navy uniform jacket and skirt. Signature: bright red neck scarf.
- THE PILOT: Korean man, about 45, short black hair. White short-sleeve pilot shirt with four-stripe gold epaulettes, black tie. Signature: gold wings badge on his chest.
- THE INFECTED: ordinary passengers with grey-pale skin, dark veins and blank white eyes, snarling and lunging. One young infected man with messy black hair wears a grey hoodie.

LOCATION: a packed wide-body passenger jet at night. Rows of navy-blue seats with glowing seatback screens, one long central aisle edged by thin white floor-light strips, curved white overhead bins, oval windows, a front galley with steel cart drawers behind a dark curtain, a beige reinforced cockpit door with a keypad, and a cockpit with glowing instrument panels. Exterior livery: white fuselage, deep crimson tail fin with a simple white abstract star-shaped emblem. Outside: a moonlit sea of clouds, then a sprawling night city of modern high-rise towers and apartment blocks with a low mountain ridge behind it.

SHOT LIST
SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:01.1) — The jet. Wide exterior side view: the jet glides right-to-left above a dark blue sea of clouds under a deep night sky, cabin windows glowing, tail fin lit. Slow tracking shot moving with the plane.
SHOT 2 (00:01.1-00:02.2) — Through the window. Medium close-up from outside the plane looking in through one oval window: the heroine sits by the window in profile, headphones on, eyes calm, gazing ahead; sleeping passengers behind her in soft lavender light. Locked-off, very slow push-in.
SHOT 3 (00:02.2-00:04.6) — The veins. Medium two-shot at seat level, lavender-blue cabin light, window behind them: Patient Zero sits on the left asleep with his head tilted, dark veins visibly creeping up his neck and cheek; the heroine beside him on the right turns her eyes to him, frowns in worry, then raises one hand to her headphones and slides them down around her neck. Slow subtle push-in.
SHOT 4 (00:04.6-00:06.8) — Lights die. The cabin lights flicker and drop to near-darkness with a dim red pulse. Closer on Patient Zero slumped in the dark; his eyes snap open pure glowing white, then his head jerks back against the headrest, mouth open, veins bulging. Handheld, slight shake from turbulence.
SHOT 5 (00:06.8-00:07.6) — First attack. Fast handheld whip pan with heavy motion blur as he lunges sideways over a seat back onto a screaming passenger.
SHOT 6 (00:07.6-00:09.8) — Masks drop. Perfectly symmetrical wide shot down the central aisle from the rear, seatback screens glowing, floor-light strips converging to the front. MUST SHOW: dozens of bright yellow oxygen masks dropping from the overhead panels all at once and swinging on clear tubes. The ceiling light shifts from white to flashing emergency red; passengers jolt and stand up. Locked-off, then a slight shake.
SHOT 7 (00:09.8-00:12.2) — The run. Handheld tracking shot from behind the heroine as she sprints down the red-lit aisle toward the front, shoving swinging yellow masks aside; blurred infected passengers lunge out from the seats on both sides.
SHOT 8 (00:12.2-00:13.1) — The cart. Medium-wide from the aisle into the bright front galley through the curtain opening: the flight attendant grits her teeth and drives a steel beverage cart loaded with juice bottles and soda straight toward camera.
SHOT 9 (00:13.1-00:14.0) — Impact. Low angle at floor level down the aisle: the cart slams into the charging infected, bottles, cans and snacks burst into the air, bodies tumble over it. Fast, heavy motion blur.
SHOT 10 (00:14.0-00:15.3) — Barricade. Medium shot inside the galley, between steel cart drawers: the heroine and the flight attendant shoulder to shoulder push the cart hard into the curtained doorway; a snarling white-eyed face pushes in behind the cart in red light.
SHOT 11 (00:15.3-00:16.0) — Bracing. Tight side close-up in red light: the flight attendant in profile and the heroine, hair falling across her face, brace their arms and push with all their weight. Handheld.
SHOT 12 (00:16.0-00:17.4) — The cockpit door. Medium shot from behind the infected young man in the grey hoodie as he pounds and rams his shoulder into the beige cockpit door with its keypad, head thrashing. Handheld, shaky.
SHOT 13 (00:17.4-00:18.4) — Inside the cockpit. Over-the-shoulder from behind the pilot's seat: glowing instrument panels, dark windshield with night clouds; the pilot turns his head back toward the banging door.
SHOT 14 (00:18.4-00:19.7) — The pilot turns. Medium close-up, frontal, locked-off: the pilot facing camera, his eyes now solid glowing white, face pale with dark veins, staring blankly; instrument lights behind him.
SHOT 15 (00:19.7-00:20.9) — The dive. Wide exterior from slightly below and in front: the jet over the clouds, landing lights blazing, banks hard and pitches nose-down into a steep dive across frame. Camera follows the roll.
SHOT 16 (00:20.9-00:22.0) — Cabin rolls. Wide interior down the aisle with the whole frame rotating as the cabin tilts steeply, light flipping from white to red, oxygen masks and debris flying sideways.
SHOT 17 (00:22.0-00:24.3) — Zero gravity. Low-angle medium-wide in red emergency light: MUST SHOW: the heroine floating weightless above her seat, held only by a loose seatbelt strap across her hips, arms spread, long hair streaming upward. Yellow oxygen masks, phones and debris float around her; infected passengers drift and claw at her from the right. A blurred grey arm sweeps across the lens at the end.
SHOT 18 (00:24.3-00:25.9) — The city. Extreme close-up framed by the oval window: the heroine's grime-smudged terrified face presses near the glass; outside, the night city skyline and glowing towers rush upward past the window, lights streaking with speed. Blue-white light.
SHOT 19 (00:25.9-00:27.6) — Hands. Same window framing, now lit deep red: MUST SHOW: the flight attendant's hand tightly clasped in the heroine's hand, fingers interlocked, held up beside her face; the heroine squeezes her eyes shut, trembling.
SHOT 20 (00:27.6-00:29.8) — The fireball. Locked-off extreme wide of the night city: modern high-rise towers on the left, a dense carpet of lights in front, a dark mountain ridge across the horizon. MUST SHOW: at 00:28.3 a massive orange fireball erupts behind the ridge in the centre-right and swells into a mushroom of flame, lighting the clouds and the whole sky orange.
SHOT 21 (00:29.8-00:30.1) — Smash cut to black.

SOUND: no dialogue, no narration. Shots 1-3: steady low jet-engine hum, faint music leaking from her headphones, soft cabin chime. Shot 4-5: electrical flicker buzz, turbulence rumble, a wet snarl, then a scream. Shots 6-7: hiss of masks dropping, rising screams, snarls, pounding footsteps, a fast tense percussion score kicking in. Shots 8-11: metal cart rattle, a crashing impact of bottles and cans, grunts of effort. Shots 12-14: heavy fists pounding the door, cockpit alarms beeping. Shots 15-19: engines screaming in the dive, an automated cockpit voice repeating "PULL UP. PULL UP.", wind roar, terrified screams, trembling breath. Shot 20: a deep distant boom and rolling explosion. Shot 21: instant total silence.
prompt_short: Photoreal Korean disaster-horror, 16:9, night jet. A young woman in a white tee and headphones watches the man beside her turn zombie; masks drop, red alarms, a cart smashes the infected, she floats in zero-g as the plane dives; a fireball erupts behind the city.
